facts.fact: UNICEF's chief of child protection said on the Friday before publication that some decentralised Civil Registry sub-offices are not currently computerised; no count is given.

UNICEF and the government are set to computerise, digitalise and solar-power 10 Civil Registry sub-offices at 10 sites in eight districts, under a China-funded project announced at the Goromonzi launch of a two-year drought programme on the Friday before publication.
The computerisation of 10 Civil Registry sub-offices is under a project funded by China and implemented by UNICEF in partnership with the government; no amount is given.
